status_effects.explanation: Norpois's deliberate courtesy toward her as maîtresse de maison marks her inclusion in the conversation, though the narrator frames it as formal duty rather than genuine interest.
The father's public correction of his stated impression, motivated by concern for Norpois's opinion, undermines the narrator's standing as a credible speaker within the staged scene.

appraisal_events.evidence: "dit Norpois en se tournant avec application vers ma mère pour ne pas la laisser en dehors de la conversation et afin de remplir consciencieusement son devoir de politesse envers une maîtresse de maison"
appraisal_events.explanation: Norpois deliberately turns to address the mother so she is not left out of the exchange, treating her with the formal courtesy owed to a hostess; the narrator's phrasing frames this attentiveness as dutiful convention rather than spontaneous interest.

appraisal_events.evidence: "Mais comment, s'écria mon père, ennuyé de l'impression fâcheuse que l'aveu de mon incompréhension pouvait produire sur Norpois, comment peux-tu dire que tu n'as pas eu de plaisir"
appraisal_events.explanation: The father publicly contradicts and corrects the narrator's admitted disappointment in front of Norpois, anxious about the impression it will make; the narrator's own phrasing exposes the father's status-anxiety, giving the correction an ironic edge.
